description: x402 spending-firewall vault on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1). init_vault, deposit, create_session, agent_pay and withdraw were verified: 15_000_000 lab tokens were deposited; a 2_000_000 agent_pay was rejected (OverRequestCap); a 1_000_000 payment to a listed merchant succeeded; withdraw returned the remaining 14_000_000 and left the vault ATA at 0.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of manasshete/allowance-solana. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/allowance-solana. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is the lab build. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (init_vault, deposit, create_session, agent_pay, withdraw)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/allowance-solana/
QA: devnet proof of listed-merchant agent_pay and OverRequestCap rejection
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
Unlisted-merchant reputation gate (8004/ATOM) and pending approvals

assignments.title: Exercise agent_pay to an unlisted merchant through the official 8004/ATOM reputation accounts
